WITH account_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order` AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
), differences AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        region,
        order_count,
        order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_avg
    FROM account_orders
), regional AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        region,
        order_count,
        difference_from_overall_avg,
        AVG(difference_from_overall_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg_difference
    FROM differences
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    region,
    order_count,
    difference_from_overall_avg,
    difference_from_overall_avg - region_avg_difference AS excess_over_region_avg
FROM regional
WHERE difference_from_overall_avg > region_avg_difference
ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
